rules.title: End-of-service award
rules.document: Labor Law, Royal Decree No. M/51 of 27 September 2005, as published by the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development
rules.reading: Article 84 sets the award itself and the wage it is computed on; the wage the article names is defined in the law's own definitions, which resolve Wage to the actual wage. Article 85 sets what a worker who resigns receives as a fraction of that award. The Ministry publishes the whole law as a PDF at the address above, which this product retrieves, hashes and reads.

fields.name: wage_basis
fields.label: Which wage the award is computed on
fields.help: Article 84 computes the award on the LAST wage. Which components that wage includes decides the amount, and this product understands exactly these three. Choosing one asserts what the law and the contract make the wage.

fields.name: days_per_year_first_five
fields.label: Days of wage per year, first five years
fields.help: Expressed as days of wage per completed year of service, on a 30-day month. A half-month is 15.

fields.name: days_per_year_after_five
fields.label: Days of wage per year, after five years
fields.help: Same unit. A whole month is 30.

fields.name: resignation_fraction_under_two_years
fields.label: Fraction on resignation, under two years
fields.help: A fraction of the Article 84 award, between 0 and 1. Write it the way the article does: 1/3 and 2/3 are accepted and are exact, where 0.3333 is a third of an award short by a riyal in every thirty thousand.

fields.name: resignation_fraction_two_to_five_years
fields.label: Fraction on resignation, two to five years
fields.help: A fraction of the Article 84 award, between 0 and 1. Write it the way the article does: 1/3 and 2/3 are accepted and are exact, where 0.3333 is a third of an award short by a riyal in every thirty thousand.

fields.name: resignation_fraction_five_to_ten_years
fields.label: Fraction on resignation, five to ten years
fields.help: A fraction of the Article 84 award, between 0 and 1. Write it the way the article does: 1/3 and 2/3 are accepted and are exact, where 0.3333 is a third of an award short by a riyal in every thirty thousand.

fields.name: resignation_fraction_over_ten_years
fields.label: Fraction on resignation, over ten years
fields.help: A fraction of the Article 84 award, between 0 and 1. Article 85 bands the fraction by length of service and this is the last band, so without it a settlement for somebody with eleven years' service has no figure to apply and the software would have to assume one. Record what the article says, including 1 if it says the whole award. Write it the way the article does: 1/3 and 2/3 are accepted and are exact, where 0.3333 is a third of an award short by a riyal in every thirty thousand.

rules.title: Wage protection submission timing
rules.reading: The published Mudad rules state how far ahead of payday a wage file must be sent, and how long after the period ends wages may be paid. Mudad cross-references GOSI and Qiwa, so a mismatch can freeze portal access rather than merely reject a file.

fields.name: lead_time_business_days
fields.label: Business days before payday the wage file is due
fields.help: Counted in business days, not calendar days.

fields.name: payment_window_days
fields.label: Days after the pay period ends within which wages must be paid
fields.help: Calendar days from the end of the pay period.

rules.title: Cross-border transfer conditions
rules.document: Regulation on Personal Data Transfer Outside the Kingdom
rules.reading: The regulation states the conditions under which personal data may leave the Kingdom. It decides hosting architecture: a second data region cannot be deployed until it is settled.

fields.name: conditions
fields.label: The conditions under which personal data may leave the Kingdom
fields.help: As the regulation states them. This decides where this deployment may host data, so record what the text says rather than what the deployment would prefer.

rules.title: Distance-selling cooling-off period
rules.reading: The regulations set the withdrawal period and name the categories exempt from it. The number of days is already on file; the exemptions are not.

fields.name: category_exemptions
fields.label: Categories exempt from the return right
fields.help: The categories the regulations exempt, as they name them. `days` is already recorded; only this is outstanding.

rules.title: Where an online store registers
rules.reading: The Ministry names the register an online store must appear in. This has been moving between Maroof and business.sa, which is why it is a recorded value rather than a constant in code.

fields.name: channel
fields.label: The register an online store must appear in
fields.help: The channel currently named by the Ministry, such as Maroof or business.sa.
